_comment: Every parameter of the whole-car builder, for the layout search -- written to layout_params.json. Mode "shape": held at value in stage 1 (the layout search), evolved by stage 2 (search/shape) with the body's lattice.

params.name: W
params.what: wheelbase, front axle -> rear axle
params.why: team car: 138.0 (measured on the team's CAD, 2026-11-22). the main layout lever: drag, mass, and where the thrust and COM sit against the axles

params.name: rear
params.what: rear axle -> body rear face (the cartridge bore moves with it); the gene is the fraction of 36 .. 207 - W
params.rule: the 223 mm block: 16 + W + rear <= 223, so rear <= 207 - W (67 at W 140, 87 at W 120). T9.4.2's 40 mm behind Ref B is the rear wing and its support only (team, 2026-11-22). Below ~35 the rear wing has no body under it.
params.why: team car: 63.75. shorter tail: less foam and wetted area, thrust point moves forward

params.name: halo_rear
params.what: halo pocket FRONT edge -> body rear face (pocket 50 mm long)
params.rule: pocket front on/behind the front axle; pocket rear ahead of the rear axle and of the 52 mm bore (the decoder keeps it inside these for each W and rear)
params.why: team car: 194.6 (pocket front 7 mm behind the front axle). moves the halo, the 25 g halo + ballast container, and the loft's peak

params.name: cargo_x
params.what: virtual cargo front -> back: 0 = its front on the front axle line, 1 = its back on the rear axle line
params.rule: T4.2 wholly between the axle lines; may share the ballast container, not the halo pocket (z 14-24 vs 24+: never overlaps)
params.why: where the body must keep 55 mm of width at z 14-24: shapes the sidepods' minimum

params.name: cargo_flip
params.what: orientation: below 0.5 wide (55 mm) end forward, above 0.5 wide end rearward
params.rule: T4.2 either way
params.why: the wide end sets where the body is widest

params.name: st_b0
params.what: half-width at u = 0.0
params.rule: T8.5.1 <= 15 half-width ahead of Ref A (the nose); T3.4 car width; the block 65 wide
params.why: set so the body front meets the nose (T8.5.1 caps the nose at 25 mm): the 7 mm step at the joint becomes ~3 mm; shape, not layout: held while the layout is searched; the free-form stage on the best layout reshapes the body

params.name: skin_mm
params.what: uniform skin offset of the drawn body (0 = as drawn); lead fills the car to 48.2 g
params.rule: T3.6 >= 48.0 g; T1.22 lead only in the container under the halo
params.why: the shape genes already set the foam

params.name: nose_len
params.what: nose tip ahead of Ref A (sets x_front = 16 + this)
params.rule: T8.2 <= 40 (whole nose assembly)
params.why: team car: 39.4.

params.name: nose_k
params.what: section growth along the nose (0.5 elliptic, 1 conical)

params.name: nose_p
params.what: nose section squareness
params.rule: T8.5.1 half-width <= 15
params.why: shape detail

params.name: nose_tip_z
params.what: tip height above the track

params.name: nose_blend
params.what: root station behind Ref A where it takes the body's section
params.why: run_car's choice

params.name: nose_root_scale
params.what: root section vs the body's

params.name: nose_wall
params.what: printed shell wall
params.rule: print minimum
params.why: mass only

params.name: fw_z
params.what: chord line height at the root
params.rule: T8.7 5 mm clear of the track; T8.5.2 <= 20 high beyond 15 mm out (front_wing_engine)
params.why: user 2026-11-22: front wing height is a parameter (wheel wake, ground effect)

params.name: fw_pieces
params.what: below 0.5 one wing across the centre line, above it a left and a right wing
params.rule: T8.6.1: 1 x 50 or 2 x 25 where another part passes through
params.why: user 2026-11-23: one piece or two, the search decides (starts at the middle)

params.name: fw_chord
params.what: chord (a flat NACA 0015, user 2026-11-22)

params.name: fw_te_gap
params.what: trailing edge ahead of Ref A
params.rule: T8.7 5 mm to the body and the wheels; T8.2 the whole wing within 40 mm of Ref A

params.name: fw_tip_y
params.what: tip, from the centre line (pushed out until each segment is 25 mm)
params.rule: T8.6.1; T3.4 car width

params.name: fw_root_y
params.what: two pieces: where each half starts (in the nose's side, or over/under it on a pylon)
params.rule: T8.5.1 support band 15 mm

params.name: wheels
params.what: the team's measured wheels (front 13.25, rear 17.25 wide)
params.why: printed parts you already have

params.name: wheel_inner_y

params.why: a Part 1 constant used by every mask

params.name: sup_chord
params.what: plate chord (x) where it leaves the body; the saddle's is at least this
params.rule: T7.12.1 inside the wheels' cylinder (the engine narrows a saddle that would not fit)
params.why: what the air sees of the support: evolved in stage 2 with the body's shape

params.name: sup_t
params.what: plate thickness (z), at least what the loads need
params.rule: loads: 3 N radial, 1.2 N side, 20 MPa, 0.15 mm sag (support_engine.py); flush with the underside (gate)
params.why: thicker is stiffer and blunter; the engine grows it until the loads pass

params.name: sup_taper
params.what: plate chord at the disc / at the body

params.name: sup_fillet
params.what: radius of the concave fillet where the arm grows into the disc

params.name: sup_saddle_h
params.what: saddle depth over the underside (the slot milled from below), at least what the loads need
params.rule: 3 mm foam over the slot or none; cut from below by the 3.175 mm ball
params.why: inside the body: the air never sees it, so it is sized, not searched

params.name: sup_disc_r
params.what: disc radius (beam_support's disc)
params.rule: inside the rim (13.72) less 0.5; T3.7
params.why: inside the wheel: not seen by the CFD

params.name: sup_disc_recess
params.what: disc's outer face inside the wheel's inner face

_owner_2026_11_28: Layout search (Bayesian) moves the wheelbase, the rear axle -> rear face, the halo -> rear face and every placement and size number of both wings within the rules; the cargo and the nose are fixed; no cone: the nose is the organic free-form nose (organic_seed.json). Stage 2 (CMA-ES) keeps these at stage 1's values. Front wing (owner 2026-11-28, later): a straight, parallel NACA 0015 at its fixed chord; the search may split it (one piece or two halves) and place it (height, gap to Ref A, root and tip across the car); its struts' shape is fixed. The rear wing is straight, one piece; its place, height, span and chord are searched.
